reason: I might throw the free 30 at it one night, but half of what my staff send is a crumpled handwritten nota from a warung or a hardware shop, and I don't believe it reads those right. If I end up checking every line anyway, I'm paying $19 to do the same job I already do in the group chat.

would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 come back with my real handwritten notas read correctly, totals right and a duplicate actually caught, with almost nothing for me to fix.
